snippet.title: Black Orchestra Project Reveal
snippet.description:
Roughly a year ago a decision has been made to merge GOM and Desert Rats development teams together in order to bring full-fledged Red Orchestra/Rising Storm franchise experience to a whole new level. 

Named Black Orchestra: Worldfront 37-54, this modification will allow you to experience an overhauled Red Orchestra 2 and Rising Storm 1 with Heroes of the West. It includes the North African campaign, as well as completely new theatres to the series. All will be explained properly in a future video, and everything you see currently is WIP and subject to change.

GET INVOLVED
https://discord.gg/pjfemrgxcV
